title: Epic Universe Modpack
description: Epic Universe is a NeoForge 1.21.10 sandbox modpack combining exploration, structures, performance, and QoL mods.
body:
🌌 Epic Universe — NeoForge 1.21.10 Modpack
Epic Universe is a curated sandbox modpack built entirely from community-created mods, designed to deliver immersive exploration, performance upgrades, and quality-of-life enhancements — all running smoothly on NeoForge 1.21.10.

This pack does not include any custom mods. Every file is used as-is, and full credit goes to the original creators. Epic Universe exists to showcase their work in one cohesive, optimized experience.

🧩 Key Features
Dimension Expansions

Moog’s End Structures by Moogthedog — Adds vanilla-style ruins and towers to the End.

Moog’s Nether Structures by Moogthedog — Expands the Nether with thematic structures and loot.

Moog’s Soaring Structures by Moogthedog — Adds floating overworld structures for vertical exploration.

Performance & Visuals

Sodium by CaffeineMC — Boosts FPS and rendering performance.

Iris by StellarSky — Enables shader support on NeoForge.

Dynamic FPS by juliand665 — Reduces resource usage when Minecraft is unfocused.

Reese’s Sodium Options by Reese — Adds a GUI for Sodium settings.

Skin Layers 3D and Not Enough Animations by tr7zw — Improves player visuals and third-person animations.

Gameplay Enhancements

Better Archeology by Resourceful Bees Team — Adds dig sites, loot, and tools for archaeology.

Netherweather by Unknown — Introduces weather effects to the Nether.

Netherited by Unknown — Expands Netherite progression.

Trek by Unknown — Adds exploration content and mechanics.

Quality of Life

Mod Menu (NeoForge Edition) by TerraformersMC — Lets players view and manage installed mods.

Better Advancements by way2muchnoise — Improves advancement UI and tracking.

Enchantment Descriptions by Darkhax — Adds tooltips for enchantments.

Cloth Config by shedaniel — Shared config library used by many mods.

Dependencies Included

Architectury API by shedaniel

Prickle by Unknown

Resourceful Config by Resourceful Bees Team

Moog’s Structure Lib by Moogthedog

🧾 Credits
All mods are created by their original authors. This pack is a curated compilation — no edits, forks, or repackaging were done. Full credit goes to:

Moogthedog — Moog’s End Structures, Nether Structures, Soaring Structures, Structure Lib

tr7zw — Skin Layers 3D, Not Enough Animations

juliand665 — Dynamic FPS

way2muchnoise — Better Advancements

Darkhax — Enchantment Descriptions

shedaniel — Cloth Config, Architectury API

Resourceful Bees Team — Better Archeology, Resourceful Config

CaffeineMC — Sodium

StellarSky — Iris

Reese — Reese’s Sodium Options

TerraformersMC — Mod Menu (NeoForge Edition)

Plus additional creators for mods like Netherweather, Netherited, Prickle, and Trek
